verdict.rationale: A hands-on community user reports that Stagehand has built-in proxies and captcha handling for adversarial scraping targets. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe stealth fingerprinting or residential/geo-targeted proxy configuration. Browserbase region selection is documented, but only for latency and data jurisdiction, which is adjacent to proxy geo-targeting rather than the capability itself. Missing for 10: documented stealth/fingerprinting configuration, documented residential proxy support, documented geo-targeted proxy selection, independent corroboration beyond a single comment.
